▪︎MMSE: baseline when starting tx + assess decline during tx; ⍉needed to establish dx; can't assess mood/thought content (⍉distinguish mood d/o); relatively insensitive to MCI + executive/language dysfunction
▪︎MRI preferred over CT for cognitive decline; neither necessary for dx w/o red flags; MRI findings: cortical atrophy, ventriculomegaly, ischemic cerebrovascular dz, microhemorrhages

▪︎CT if acute onset, rapid deterioration, recent head trauma, or PE suggests stroke; less sensitive than MRI (choose if claustrophobia, extreme body habitus, movement d/o, metal hardware, some pacemakers)
